_comment: GitHub App manifest for the 'developing-today kaneo' app. Used with GitHub's app-manifest flow: POST this JSON as the 'manifest' form field to https://github.com/organizations/developing-today/settings/apps/new (signed in as an org owner). GitHub redirects to redirect_url with a temporary ?code=; exchange it once with POST https://api.github.com/app-manifests/{code}/conversions to receive the App ID, slug, PEM private key and webhook secret, which then go into secrets/pm-stack.sops.yaml (and Bitwarden/1Password). If the name is taken, append a suffix and update GITHUB_APP_NAME to the resulting slug. The webhook secret and private key returned by the conversion are the ones Kaneo must use — do not invent your own.
name: developing-today kaneo
